tools.name: trainrec_food_day
tools.description: Everything eaten on one day, each entry with its id and version, totals by meal and for the day, and what is left of the targets.

tools.name: trainrec_recent_changes
tools.description: The latest changes to this log, newest first, with who made each one and its seq number.

tools.description: Plans a workout for the person to do: saves it in TrainRec, where their phone and watch walk them through it one set at a time, with each set's target (weight and reps, time or distance) and the rest after it. tools.name: trainrec_save_workout

tools.name: trainrec_delete_workout
tools.description: Removes one workout, given its id and version. The person can undo it in the app.

tools.description: Adds one or more food entries, each with its numbers PER SERVING and the number of servings. perServing takes the macros and any label nutrient (sodiumMg, potassiumMg and the rest); a nutrient left out counts as unknown, not zero. tools.name: trainrec_edit_food
tools.description: Changes fields of one food entry, given its id and version. Fields left out stay as they are; perServing is replaced whole.

tools.name: trainrec_delete_food
tools.description: Removes one food entry, given its id and version. The person can undo it in the app.

tools.name: trainrec_save_routine
tools.description: Creates a routine (a reusable workout plan the person starts from the app), or replaces one given its id and version. Same shape as a workout, without a day.

tools.name: trainrec_get_routine
tools.description: One routine with every set, in the person's unit, and its version.

tools.name: trainrec_delete_routine
tools.description: Removes one routine, given its id and version. Workouts already done from it stay. The person can undo it in the app.

tools.name: trainrec_add_exercise
tools.description: Makes a custom exercise with a name, kind and muscles. equipment: "plate" for a plate-loaded machine or "smith" for a Smith machine gives it a sled or bar its base weight is counted from (change_settings baseWeight).

tools.name: trainrec_undo_change
tools.description: Puts a record back the way it was before one change, given the change's seq. Refused if the record has been changed again since.

tools.name: trainrec_measurements
tools.description: Body measurements over time, one kind at a time, one value per day (the last reading of the day), in the person's units, newest last: weight, body fat, tape measurements, calories eaten per day, resting heart rate, HRV, blood pressure and sleep, and from Oura readiness, sleep score, temperature chan

tools.description: Records one measurement: weight, body fat, a tape measurement, blood pressure, resting heart rate, HRV or sleep, in the unit given (lb, kg, %, in, cm, bpm, ms, mmHg, min). Blood pressure takes systolic as value and diastolic as value2.

tools.name: trainrec_delete_measurement
tools.description: Removes one reading, given its id and version. The person can undo it in the app.

tools.name: trainrec_import_measurements
tools.description: Imports past measurements (weight, body fat, tape, blood pressure, resting heart rate, HRV, sleep, daily calories), each with its time as the source wrote it, kind, value and unit, and origin when the source names one. Up to 1000 per call; the same batch id on later calls makes one import. Readings

tools.name: trainrec_import_workouts
tools.description: Imports past workouts from another app or file. Exercises are matched to existing ones by name; unmatched names become custom exercises, listed in the result. Up to 100 workouts per call; the same batch id on later calls makes one import, undone together. Workouts already imported from the same app

tools.name: trainrec_import_food
tools.description: Imports past meals from another nutrition app or file: each entry's day, meal, name, numbers PER SERVING and servings. Up to 200 entries per call; the same batch id on later calls makes one import, undone together. Entries already imported from the same app are skipped.

tools.name: trainrec_undo_import
tools.description: Removes everything one import added, given its batch id. All or nothing: refused if any of it has been edited since.

tools.name: trainrec_reminders
tools.description: The person's reminders (notifications on their phone): what each says, when, whether it is on, and who set it up. Read-only.

tools.name: trainrec_set_reminder
tools.description: Reminders are TrainRec's notifications on the person's phone. They start at zero: none exist until the person asks their assistant (you) to set one up, so when they ask to be reminded of something, this is how. tools.name: trainrec_delete_reminder
tools.description: Removes one reminder, given its id and version. To stop it for a while instead, set_reminder with on false. The person can undo it in the app.

tools.name: trainrec_find_issues
tools.description: Bugs and ideas already sent to the TrainRec team that look like what the person describes, best match first, with whether each is fixed. Call this before report_issue: if one matches, add to it rather than sending a new one. Read-only.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "trainrec_set_reminder" is 1192 chars, far longer than this server's median (226). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: trainrec_reminders, trainrec_find_issues · Private data: trainrec_exercise_history, trainrec_undo_change, trainrec_log_measurement, trainrec_import_file, trainrec_import_workouts, trainrec_import_food · Public sink: trainrec_report_issue · Destructive: trainrec_delete_workout, trainrec_delete_food, trainrec_delete_routine, trainrec_delete_measurement, trainrec_delete_reminder.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: trainrec_reminders, trainrec_find_issues · Private data: trainrec_exercise_history, trainrec_undo_change, trainrec_log_measurement, trainrec_import_file, trainrec_import_workouts, trainrec_import_food · Public sink: trainrec_report_issue · Destructive: trainrec_delete_workout, trainrec_delete_food, trainrec_delete_routine, trainrec_delete_measurement, trainrec_delete_reminder

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
